data.name: Gatik
data.gender_notes: Gatik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'gam' meaning 'to go' or 'move', Gatik means 'speedy' or 'swift'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of the charioteer of the sun god Surya, who drives the sun across the sky each day. The name Gatik carries the meaning “Speedy, Swift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gatik usually hope their child will grow to embody speedy, swift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes swift action and quick thinking in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Gatik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Speedy, Swift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gatik total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
